{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Now, compute average revenue per converted order: only among orders where converted == 1
# Group by channel and compute mean revenue only for converted orders
avg_revenue_converted_only = filtered_df[filtered_df['converted'] == 1].groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()

# Also compute conversion rate (converted = 1)
conversion_rate_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute number of converted orders per channel
num_converted_by_channel = filtered_df[filtered_df['converted'] == 1].groupby('channel').size()

# Print results
print("Average revenue per converted order (only among converted orders):")
print(avg_revenue_converted_only)
print("\nNumber of converted orders per channel:")
print(num_converted_by_channel)
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)"}
